entries.25d70042bcbd4312: A business made up of the Computer Business and the Service & Support Business. In addition to selling servers, computers, printers, toner, peripherals, network-related equipment, business software and other products, it carries out installation and configuration, system maintenance, on-site help desk services, production of Web sites and digital signage, manufacture, planning and sale of security systems for small and medium-sized enterprises, IT consulting, and software development and maintenance.
